run_generation_task: run a GenerationTask with a predictor to generate text and compute metrics on a dataset
run_choice_task: run a ChoiceTask with a predictor to compute NLL-based accuracy on multiple choice questions
create_generation_task_config: create a GenerationTaskConfig with max_gen_len, num_generations, and metric_fns for text generation evaluation
create_choice_task_config: create a ChoiceTaskConfig with nll_completion and prompt_func for multiple choice evaluation
compute_nll_accuracy: compute the nll_accuracy metric function to calculate accuracy and normalized NLL from negative log-likelihoods
